WITH team_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    SUM(games) as total_games
  FROM home_game
  GROUP BY team_id
),
aggregate_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(total_games) as total_all_games,
    COUNT(*) as num_teams,
    CAST(SUM(total_games) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as average_games
  FROM team_totals
)
SELECT 
  t.team_id,
  t.total_games,
  CAST(t.total_games AS REAL) / agg.total_all_games as share,
  CAST(t.total_games AS REAL) / agg.average_games as ratio
FROM team_totals t
CROSS JOIN aggregate_stats agg
WHERE t.total_games IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
